    """Find regions of consecutive uniform non-zero rows"""
    regions = []

        first_nonzero = None

        uniform_rows = [r]
        
        # Extend to next consecutive uniform rows

        if first_nonzero == -1 or grid[r][first_nonzero] == 0:
            # This row has only zeros, skip to next

        uniform_val = grid[r][first_nonzero]
        uniform_rows = []
        
        # Check each subsequent row
        rr = r
        while rr < rows:
            # Check if all cells in this row are uniform_val
            is_uniform = True
